s.note: the Mindil Beach sunset markets in Darwin
s.how: Fry 3 tbsp laksa paste for 2 minutes, add 400ml coconut milk and 500ml water and simmer. Add 300g sliced chicken thighs and cook 8 minutes, then 100g tofu puffs. Divide 200g cooked rice noodles into 8 cups, ladle over the laksa and top with bean sprouts.

s.n: Darwin mango and prawn rice paper rolls
s.how: Soak 100g rice vermicelli in boiling water 5 minutes, drain and cool. Peel and halve 400g cooked prawns. Slice 2 mangoes and 1 cucumber into strips. Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds, lay flat, add prawns, mango, cucumber, noodles, mint and Vietnamese mint and roll tightly. Make 12. Mix 3 tbsp fish sauce, 3 tbsp lime juice, 2 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp water, 1 chopped chilli and 1 garlic clove.

m.note: tracking Lauren's mum down on the Tiwi Islands
m.how: Score 4 barramundi fillets (about 180g each) and season. Grill skin down over high heat for 5 minutes, flip for 2. Toss 1 shredded green mango with mint, 1 sliced chilli, the juice of 2 limes and 1 tbsp fish sauce and pile on top.

w.note: the wedding they've got ten days to pull off
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Shape a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 2 sliced mangoes and 3 passionfruit.

d.note: a steaming Darwin afternoon before the wedding
d.how: Freeze the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes in chunks for at least 2 hours. Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli flakes, wet the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip. Blend the frozen mango with 160ml white rum, 80ml lime juice, 40ml sugar syrup and 2 cups ice until thick and slushy. Pour into the glasses and add a lime wheel. Leave out the rum and add 100ml coconut water for non-drinkers.
